answer.worked: The right triangles EDC and ABC have equal vertical angles at C, so they are similar by AAA. Matching vertical and horizontal legs give $\frac{x}{17}=\frac{6}{11}$, hence $x=\frac{102}{11}\text{ cm}$.

answer.worked: The smaller upper right triangle is similar to the full right-hand triangle by AAA: both are right-angled and share the angle at A. Thus $\frac{x}{(x+6)}=\frac{7}{15}$. Cross-multiply: $15x=7x+42$, so $8x=42$ and $x=\frac{21}{4}$.
